description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Rapid City, SD. This vital role is instrumental in ensuring accurate patient assessments and comprehensive care planning, directly impacting the quality of care provided to our residents. If you are passionate about compliance and patient advocacy, this is an excellent opportunity to make a significant difference.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing individualized care plans, and ensuring adherence to federal and state regulations. Your expertise will contribute to optimizing resident outcomes and maintaining the highest standards of care within a supportive and collaborative environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in South Dakota
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficient knowledge of MDS 3.0, RAI process, and Medicare/Medicaid regulations
Strong assessment, documentation, and organizational skills
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team

description:

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Certified Dietary Manager to lead the dietary services at a premier skilled nursing facility in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL. You'll enjoy a supportive work environment and the chance to contribute to a community that values both its residents and staff.As the Certified Dietary Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the dietary department, ensuring the provision of high-quality, nutritious meals that meet resident needs and regulatory standards. This is an urgent hire, offering a competitive salary for the right candidate.

description:

description:

Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Physical Therapist, preferably in a home health or mobile therapy setting.
Strong clinical assessment, treatment, and documentation skills.

description:
